production.verifiedHeadSubject: docs: pin final report to the live production deployment (#23)

tatumSuiMainnet.role: Authoritative, read-only verifier of Sui transaction execution status. It is the only evidence source that can establish whether a reported transaction actually executed.
tatumSuiMainnet.interface: Tatum Sui Mainnet gRPC (primary; fallback: Tatum Sui Mainnet GraphQL)

health.detail: Tatum Sui Mainnet gRPC reachable and authenticated (chain mainnet).

liveOnChainLookups.method: POST /api/incidents/submit (anonymous, public submission enabled) with a Sui transaction digest in the material. AFTERMATH inferred domain=finance and performed a read-only lookup through Tatum.

cases.decisionReason: Authoritative evidence establishes success, so the completion claim may stand.
cases.counterfactual: Without the Tatum lookup this success claim would be an unsupported claim and could not be allowed.

cases.decisionReason: Authoritative evidence establishes the transaction failed; the reported success is refused.
cases.counterfactual: A success claim contradicted by the ledger is blocked because Tatum reported the true outcome.

cases.lookupDetail: The node holds no transaction for this digest. It may not exist, or may have been pruned. Success is not established.
cases.counterfactual: An unresolvable digest never becomes a fabricated verdict; the claim is deferred.

cases.lookupDetail: The gateway rejected the digest as malformed. No transaction outcome can be established from this request.
cases.counterfactual: A rejected lookup is reported as unknown, never as a transaction failure.

independentCrossCheck.method: The same digests were queried directly against Tatum's public Sui Mainnet GraphQL endpoint (read-only) from outside the application.
independentCrossCheck.agreement: The application's verdicts (ALLOW for the SUCCESS digest, BLOCK for the FAILURE digest) match the ledger state observed independently.

behaviourChange.claim: Tatum is load-bearing: removing it changes the verdict.
behaviourChange.evidence: The same class of submission (a success claim naming a Sui digest) resolves to ALLOW when the chain confirms success, BLOCK when the chain reports failure, and REQUIRE_VERIFICATION when the chain cannot answer. The decision is a function of Tatum's answer, not of the agent's claim.

knownLimitations: The JSON-RPC interface at the legacy rpcUrl is no longer served by Tatum; gRPC is the primary interface and GraphQL the fallback. The legacy JSON-RPC adapter remains in the tree but is not wired.
Tatum AI Builder (the optional $500 bonus track) is not used. The AI-assisted reading runs on Groq, not on Tatum's AI.

The Tatum API key is a sensitive Vercel environment variable and cannot be decrypted through the Vercel API; its presence is confirmed through the application's own reported health rather than by reading the value.
Tatum's gateway rate-limits rapid lookups; the retry adapter backs off, so a burst can surface as a retryable condition rather than an immediate verdict.
